components.name: Bento Card
components.description: Feature card with soft teal-tinted shadow.
components.css: .ds-card{background:#fff;color:hsl(0 0% 7%);padding:1.5rem;border-radius:1.5rem;border:1px solid hsl(192 100% 20%/.1);box-shadow:0 14px 40px -30px hsl(192 100% 20%/.35);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;transition:box-shadow .3s}.ds-card:hover{box-shadow:0 20px 50px -30px hsl(192 100% 20%/.45)}.ds-card h3{margin:0 0 .5rem;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:hsl(215 16% 47%);font-size:.875rem}

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a well-run studio where careers are tailored: calm paper-white surfaces, a single deep teal that signals competence, and one decisive red-pink reserved for the next step. Cards are generous and softly lifted, so content feels crafted and orderly rather than loud.
keyCharacteristics: Deep teal carries trust, with links, headings, surfaces and focus rings all in teal
Red-pink appears only on primary calls to action
Large, soft radii and long teal-tinted shadows
One sans family (Inter) for nearly everything, with Playfair Display held back as an editorial accent
Light and dark themes share the same hues

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Signal Pink marks the single next step. If a section has no action, it has no pink.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Washes and shadows lean teal. Do not drop in neutral grey shadows or cool-grey panels beside the brand surfaces.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Colors are HSL variables in src/index.css. Never hardcode brand hex in components.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: Every heading is bold with tight tracking; headings do not go light-weight.

rules.name: The Long Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows use a large blur with a strongly negative spread so they read as ambient glow, never as hard drop shadows.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border) rather than raw colors.
Do reserve Signal Pink (hsl(349 95% 50%)) for the one primary action in a view.
Do use teal-tinted long shadows and the 1.5rem bento radius for feature cards.
Do keep sections on the py-16 md:py-24 rhythm inside .section-container.
Do provide a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for any looping decoration.
donts: Don't add a new brand color without an HSL token in src/index.css and a Tailwind mapping.
Don't use pink for decoration, icons, or secondary links.
Don't use hard drop shadows or neutral-grey shadows beside teal surfaces.
Don't edit src/components/ui/ by hand; use the shadcn CLI.
Don't assume brand and surface tokens change in dark mode; only the core tokens do, so verify dark surfaces explicitly.
